press_references.value: Century Aluminum Joins EGA Project to Build First U.S. Smelter in Almost 50 Years

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium and Century Aluminum Company entered a joint development agreement to form a 60/40 joint venture to build a large new primary aluminum smelter in Inola, Oklahoma.

press_references.value: Emirates Global Aluminium expects copper substitution and capacity limits to drive demand

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium and Century Aluminum are partnering to build a primary aluminium smelter in Oklahoma, with EGA holding a 60% stake and Century 40% in the 750,000-ton-per-year project.

press_references.value: EGA, TAQA, DUBAL Holding and EWEC sign agreements to decarbonise aluminium production and expand renewable and clean energy development in Abu Dhabi

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium signed Abu Dhabi’s largest-ever long-term electricity supply agreements with EWEC and TAQA Distribution, securing 23 TWh per year for 24 years with growing renewable and clean energy content.

press_references.value: EGA to deliver first-ever CelestiAL-R billets to leading Japanese manufacturer Sankyo Tateyama

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) announced a new agreement to supply CelestiAL-R billets to Sankyo Tateyama, with ITOCHU Corporation as a strategic partner, strengthening their long-standing partnership and supporting Japan's demand for low-carbon aluminium.

press_references.value: EGA supplies CelestiAL solar aluminium to Brembo, global leader in braking solutions

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) and Brembo have announced an extension and significant increase in their supply agreement, with EGA providing more of its CelestiAL solar aluminium to Brembo for use in high-performance braking systems. The partnership supports sustainability goals and reduces emissions in the automotive supply chain.

press_references.value: EGA receives 900 applications from young Emiratis at National Service Career Fair

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium signed an agreement with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research to provide scholarships to UAE National students in subjects relevant to EGA talent needs.

press_references.value: EGA Launches Third Season of ‘Ramp Up’ for UAE Entrepreneurs

partnership_announcements.description: Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) has launched the third season of its 'Ramp Up' entrepreneurship development programme in partnership with C3 and Microsoft UAE. The initiative aims to empower young entrepreneurs in the UAE with mentorship, training, and networking opportunities, focusing on sustainable and tech-driven business models.

about_short_description.short_description: Emirates Global Aluminium is an industrial company that produces aluminum.

product.name: Primary Aluminium
product.description: Cast primary aluminium produced from alumina through smelting, supplied in more than 330 product specifications for manufacturing and industrial applications.

product.name: CelestiAL Solar Aluminium
product.description: Primary aluminium produced using solar-generated electricity, providing a lower-carbon aluminium option for customers seeking to reduce the emissions associated with metal production.

product.name: RevivAL Recycled Aluminium
product.description: Recycled aluminium produced from post-consumer and industrial aluminium scrap at EGA’s recycling facilities in Germany and the United States.

product.name: Alumina
product.description: Refined alumina, an intermediate raw material used in aluminium smelting and supplied from EGA’s integrated refining operations.

product.name: Water
product.description: Water produced at EGA power plants, used in the company’s operations with surplus volumes available for sale.

product.name: EGA’s Technology Solutions
product.description: Aluminium smelting technology developed by EGA and licensed internationally for use in aluminium production facilities.
